d: Saudi Arabia says it has intercepted five drones, including in the Medina region, as tensions with Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis escalate. But the Houthis deny targeting the kingdom, while claiming fresh missile strikes on Saudi-backed forces in Aden. Attacks near Aden’s airport and footage of alleged drone strikes along the Jizan and Asir border fronts add to Riyadh’s security concerns. With the fragile Yemen truce in tatters and the wider West Asia war intensifying, can Saudi Arabia stop the conflict from spreading further? Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America.
